cmd: xtcp2-nl-ipmon c0 "monitor nexthop maddress" "ip nexthop replace id 1 via 192.0.2.250 dev c0" "id 1 via 192.0.2.250 dev c0 scope link"
desc: corner: a member's gateway replaced, no bucket notification — the buckets do not move
pre: n=$(ip netns identify $$) && ip netns set "$n" 0 && ip link add c0 type dummy && ip link set c0 up && ip addr add 192.0.2.1/24 dev c0 && ip nexthop add id 1 via 192.0.2.254 dev c0 && ip nexthop add id 2 via 192.0.2.253 dev c0 && ip nexthop add id 10 group 1/2 type resilient buckets 4 idle_timer 60 unbalanced_timer 1
